name: client-onboarding-checklist
description:
Produces a complete client onboarding workflow including discovery call agenda,
contract checklist, kickoff document, communication expectations, and first
deliverable timeline. Creates a reusable onboarding process document.
Use when the user needs to onboard a new freelance or consulting client, create
a structured onboarding process, or set up a new client engagement with clear
expectations and milestones.
Do NOT use for employee onboarding (use HR skills), project kickoff for internal
teams (use project management skills), or writing client proposals (use
freelance-proposal-writer).
